author: Passively
body:
Howdy members of the Avicus Network, I got kicked from Horizon so I wanted to make a LFT. It's the first time I got kicked from Cronus (horizon) so I'm kinda sad but anyways.

Info:
Discord: Passively#7027
Old Usernames: AbusiveUser
Experience: I have experience with competitive teams, a lot of team on Overcast Network (some decent teams like Night Vision) and Avicus (Cronus mainly)
Languages: Spanish and English

Cons:
Low/No activity in the mornings: Scrimming at the morning isn't the best timing for a Scrimmage for me, so I will try to scrimmage on afternoons.

Thanks for reading this, love ya <3 (vouches are also great :))
